title: session use/new archive finished sessions that still hold an open human gate
symptom: A finished session with a non-empty awaiting_human list is moved to .chough/sessions/archive/ by another session's session new or session use, dropping the open gate without a recorded decision
trigger: chough session new <key> or chough session use <key> while another open session is finished (stage done or native change archived on HEAD) and has an open awaiting-human gate
expected: Switches archive only sessions doctor would close mechanically (finished_session, no open gate); a gated finished session stays open and is named with a recovery (REQ-history-006, REQ-history-012)
actual: Both gated sessions are archived alongside the ungated one; kept_open is empty
steps: Open two finished sessions, one with an open awaiting-human gate
Both are archived; the gate is dropped
